appraisal_events.evidence: Il leur fit au contraire une excellente impression... cette aisance, cette grâce des mouvements de ceux dont les membres assouplis exécutent exactement ce qu'ils veulent
appraisal_events.explanation: Where Odette's description of Swann as 'smart' had made the Verdurins fear an 'ennuyeux', his easy, unaffected social manner instead makes an excellent impression on the whole circle.

appraisal_events.evidence: Swann demanda à faire la connaissance de tout le monde, même d'un vieil ami des Verdurin, Saniette, à qui sa timidité, sa simplicité et son bon coeur avaient fait perdre partout la considération... excita chez Saniette une sympathie ardente
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann's unusual courtesy in seeking out Saniette, a man who has lost consideration everywhere despite his merits, briefly reverses Saniette's habitual disregard and wins him ardent sympathy.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Swann ? Qui ça, Swann ! » hurla-t-il au comble d'une anxiété... cet homme qui se croyait perpétuellement préparé à tout; puis, croyant Swann prudhommesque pour avoir dit « un bonheur » sérieusement, il conclut ironiquement : « Un bonheur pour la France ! »
appraisal_events.explanation: Cottard's chronic anxiety flares at an unfamiliar name, and he later masks his own social insecurity by preemptively mocking Swann's ordinary word as pretentious, again exposing his awkwardness rather than any real wit.

status_effects.explanation: Swann's polished, unaffected manner is praised, contrasting favorably with the dullness the Verdurins had feared.
The whole Verdurin circle witnesses and registers a favorable reception of Swann, a collectively marked rise in his local standing within the salon.
Swann's courteous attention momentarily restores some of the consideration Saniette normally lacks in this circle, winning him genuine warmth.
Cottard's anxious overreaction and his defensive, misfiring mockery of Swann's word choice again expose his social unease.
